description: Three pages introduce a student-run organization that pairs artists with scientific journals. Two content collections drive a 19-person roster of co-presidents, artists, investigators, and interns plus a five-cover portfolio, while eight journal collaborations and two testimonies sit in static arrays. Light and dark themes follow the system setting until a visitor overrides it, and six hand-drawn doodle SVGs layer behind headings set in four font families.
name: Figure Zero Project
